root_cause: Netlify production failed with exit code 2 because tools/site-shell/pricing-build-integrity.mjs contained invalid JavaScript RegExp string quoting. The syntax failure happened before the intended build logic could execute.
prevention: Every production-critical Node build script changed in a PR must pass node --check or equivalent syntax validation before merge.
A Netlify build exit code 2 must be reproduced against the exact production-source artifact before changing unrelated application, SEO or i18n code.
After fixing a production build parser error, explicitly retrigger the canonical Production Source Snapshot when the workflow is path-scoped and would otherwise not run.
LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires provider success, exact release.json SHA/context/deploy-id and production browser proof.
